ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels constituting approximately 15% primarily in linear and focal patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes; a dense network of high-contrast linear streaks is distributed across the dark field of the central and lateral fluke regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped vertex; pixel-calculated angle is approximately 115 degrees with a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the outer thirds of the trailing edge; the regions proximal to the median notch exhibit lower frequency variations and smoother linear boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upward-tapering, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity pixel clusters observed at the extreme left and right distal tips, indicating irregular surface texture at the lobe peripheries.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional network of high-contrast white linear disruptions (scratches) covering the majority of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring across the ventral surface; distinct irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately two-thirds from the center.
